newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern files motion vs Conrail.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern files motion vs Conrail.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said on Friday it filed a motion in U.S. District Court in Philadelphia to block Conrail Inc from postponing a scheduled December 23 shareholder meeting
At the meeting,shareholders would be asked to waive a Pennsylvania law that requires an all-cash payment by CSX Corp, which already has purchased 19.9 percent of Conrail in a cash tender offer.
CSX and Conrail have proposed an $8.5 billion merger in which CSX buys 40 percent of Conrail in cash and the rest in stock.
Norfolk Southern has submitted a higher bid for Conrail, valued at about $10 billion, and it is an all-cash offer.
Norfolk Southern said Conrail and CSX are "subverting the processes of corporate democracy" by trying to prevent the vote from proceeding on the Pennsylvania Fair Value Statute.
